The Hydrance Boost Concentrated Hydrating Serum was disappointing. For a product that claims to provide deep hydration, it fell short. After using it for several weeks, I didn't notice any significant improvement in my skin's moisture levels. In fact, it left my skin feeling sticky and slightly greasy, especially under makeup. The texture is runny and doesn't absorb as well as I expected. Also, the scent is quite strong and not pleasant for something meant for sensitive skin. For the price point, I was expecting much better results. There are definitely more effective hydrating serums on the market that provide better results without the greasy finish or overpowering scent. Wouldn't recommend this product.

Absolutely love this serum. It's the first thing that goes on my face in my regime. I didn't always use it, until I got a sample in a previous order, and added the full size in my next order. It's honestly my favorite part of my whole regime. My skin is sensitive and reactive. This does not bother me a bit and I'm positive it makes my skin smoother and more refreshed looking and feeling. The rest of my products go on really well after this. I don't wear make up often, but when I do I use a color correcting primer for redness mixed with a moisturizing liquid concealer and they go on really well and smooth after washing and moisturizing with my Avène products—even better since I added this serum into my routine. Specifically, several of the Avène collections are highly fragranced which, in spite of quality and effectiveness, I don't love (the intense floral-type fragrances). This hydrance serum, however, is the most pleasant smell in the world to me. If I were to describe it, I'd say it smells faintly like wildflowers and pine trees in sunshine. It's hard to describe. It isn't harsh, it's fresh and subtle, and honestly I wish Avène made every product fragrances like this one. I wish this serum came in an even larger size to use all over post-shower. I hope it is never discontinued or changed, it's perfect.
